verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              रथस्थं पुरुषव्याघ्रं दृष्ट्वा कर्णमवस्थितम्। दृष्टो दुर्योधनो राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said O monarch, seeing that foremost of men Karna scated on his car, Duryodhana highly enraptured, spoke these words.

verses.sanskrit: सनाथमिव मन्येऽहं भवता पालितं बलम्। अत्र किं नु समर्थं यद्धितं तत् संप्रधार्यताम्॥२॥

कर्ण उवाच।
              ब्रूहि नः पुरुषव्याघ्र त्वं हि प्राज्ञतमो नृप। यथा चार्थपतिः कृत्यं पश्यते न तथेतरः॥३॥
verses.english: Karna said O foremost of men, yourself speak to us, since you are the wisest of kings. A third person cannot so well descry as to what should be done, as he who is interested in any affair.

verses.sanskrit: ते स्म सर्वे तव वचः श्रोतुकामा नरेश्वर। नान्याय्यं हि भवान् वाक्यं बूयादिति मतिर्मम॥४॥

दुर्योधन उवाच।
              भीष्मः सेनाप्रणेतासीद्वयसा विक्रमेण च। श्रुतेन चोपसंपन्नः सर्वैर्योधगणैस्तथा॥५॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said Owing to his prowess, seniority, knowledge of the Srutis and the support he obtained from all the warriors, he (Bhishma) was the leader of our host. In the fair battle of these ten days that highly glorious one of generous soul, O Karna, slew a large number of my foes and protected my own army.

verses.sanskrit: तेनातियशसा कर्ण घ्नता शत्रुगणान्मम। सुयुद्धेन दशाहानि पालिताः स्मो महात्मना॥६॥
तस्मिन्नसुकरं कर्म कृतवत्यास्थिते दिवम्। कं नु सेनाप्रणेतारं मन्यसे तदनन्तरम्॥७॥
न विना नायकं सेना मुहूर्तमपि तिष्ठति। आहवेष्वाहवश्रेष्ठ नेतृहीनेव नौर्जले॥८॥
यथा ह्यकर्णधारा नौ रथश्चासारथिर्यथा। द्रवेद्यथेष्टं तद्वत्स्यादृते सेनापतिं बलम्॥९॥
अदेशिको यथा सार्थः सर्वः कृच्छ्रं समृच्छति। अनायका तथा सेना सर्वान् दोषान्समर्छति॥१०॥
verses.english: Just as a foreign trader in an unknown country reaps all distress, so an army without a commander is exposed to all dangers.

verses.sanskrit: स भवान् वीक्ष्य सर्वेषु मामकेषु महात्मसु। पश्य सेनापतिं युक्तमनु शान्तनवादिह॥११॥
verses.english: Therefore do you look among all these high-souled warriors of ours and find out a proper person who may, as a commander, fill the place of Shantanu's son.

verses.sanskrit: यं हि सेनाप्रणेतारं भवान् वक्ष्यति संयुगे। तं वयं सहिताः सर्वे करिष्यामो न संशयः॥१२॥
verses.english: The person, who you will consider to be fit to lead our army, in battle, will undoubtedly be chosen to be so unanimously.

verses.sanskrit:
कर्ण उवाच।
              सर्व एव महात्मान इमे पुरुषसत्तमाः। सेनापतित्वमर्हन्ति नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥१३॥
verses.english: Karna said All these foremost of men of high soul are worthy of the leadership (of this host). There is no necessity for making any selection. ever one

verses.sanskrit: कुलसंहननज्ञानैर्बलविक्रमबुद्धिभिः। युक्ताः श्रुतज्ञा धीमन्त आहवेष्वनिवर्तिनः॥१४॥
verses.english: All of them are perfectly acquainted with the genelogies (of princes) and with the vital parts of the body; they are possessed of prowess, might and intelligence; they are grateful, highly intelligent and unretreating from battle.

verses.sanskrit: युगपन्न तु ते शक्याः कर्तुं सर्वे पुरःसराः। एक एव तु कर्तव्यो यस्मिन् वैशेषिका गुणाः॥१५॥
verses.english: But all of them cannot at the same time assume the leadership; therefore only one among them is to be chosen, in whom there reside superior qualities.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यस्पर्धिनां ह्येषां यद्येकं यं करिष्यसि। शेषा विमनसो व्यक्तं न योत्स्यन्ति हितास्तव॥१६॥
verses.english: If you promote among several contending rivals, the rest, it is clear, being depressed, will not fight with a desire for doing your good.

verses.sanskrit: अयं च सर्वयोधानामाचार्यः स्थविरो गुरुः। युक्तः सेनापतिः कर्तुं द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः॥१७॥
verses.english: But this foremost of all the wielders of weapons, this preceptor and teacher, of all the warriors, this Drona who is venerable in years, is worthy of being elected generalissimo.

verses.sanskrit: को हि तिष्ठति दुर्धर्षे द्रोणे शस्त्रभृतां वरे। सेनापतिःस्यादन्योस्माच्छुक्रांगिरसदर्शनात्॥१८॥
verses.english: When the indomitable Drona, who is foremost among those conversant with Brahma and is equal to Shuka and Angirasa in learning, is here, who else is worthy of being selected as a leader?

verses.sanskrit: न च सोऽप्यस्ति ते योधः सर्वराजसु भारत। द्रोणं यः समरे यान्तमनुयास्यति संयुगे॥१९॥
verses.english: O Bharata, there is not even a single warrior among this mighty host of kings, who will not follow Drona when he goes to fight.

verses.sanskrit: एष सेनाप्रणेतॄणामेष शस्त्रभृतामपि। एष बुद्धिमतां चैव श्रेष्ठो राजन् गुरुस्तव॥२०॥
verses.english: O monarch, this one is the foremost of all leaders of warriors; he is the foremost of all wielders of arms, as also of all intelligent persons and he is also your preceptor (in arms).

verses.sanskrit: एवं दुर्योधनाचार्यमाशु सेनापतिं कुरु। जिगीषन्तो सुरान् संख्ये कार्तिकेमिवामराः॥२१॥
verses.english: As the immortals desirous of defeating the Asuras in battle made Kartikeya their leader, so, do you, O Duryodhana, soon elect this one (Drona) as the leader of your army.
